ledger: Round table with red cloth and cream central oval | close overhead view, oval fills center, red patterned border with printed coin spots visible around rim | wider elevated view from pulled-back arced angle, same oval and border pattern | camera pulls back and arcs ~60-90 deg around table, ellipse foreshortening and border reveal evolve smoothly

Four red cups with metallic interiors | diamond cluster on cream area (frontmost cup nearest camera, one middle cup with coin on rim, two rear cups) | same four cups still on cream area in shallow arc/line | remain within cream area, left-right ordering shifts consistently with camera orbit, no teleport

Performer in blue suit with red tie | only hands/forearms at table edge visible | full upper body (glasses, beard) seated at table edge facing table | progressively revealed as camera widens, stays on same side of table throughout

Room architecture - windows, chairs, walls | blurred background with dark chairs and indistinct windows | far wall with tall bright windows behind performer and chairs along side walls, depth-of-field sharper | background parallax shifts smoothly with camera arc, window wall remains behind performer as expected for stationary sitter

Camera viewpoint and occlusion | low close overhead looking slightly across table | elevated wider angle from side-front, looking across table toward window wall | smooth continuous pull-back and orbit, nearer hands/cups correctly occlude farther table/coins/background with no inversion

Loose gold coins scattered on table | ~5-7 coins on cream and red areas near cups | similar scatter with some coins lifted/handled by hands | coins stay on table plane, occlusion by cups and hands evolves smoothly as hands move
